description: Add or remove identifiers on the website's brand, or on one competitor, under the same rules as the Competitors page. Call get_identifiers first. The name and domain cannot be removed. An identifier that is already listed, or that another tracked brand or competitor on this website already uses, is refused, and nothing is saved. New AI responses use the change right away. Past responses are reanalyzed only when someone runs the backfill on the Competitors page, which costs credits; this tool never starts it. changes_awaiting_backfill counts the edits waiting for it, not responses.

add.description: Identifiers to add, exactly as they should match (trimmed).

competitor_id.description: The competitor to read or edit, from get_competitors. Omit it for the website's own brand.

remove.description: Identifiers to remove, exactly as get_identifiers lists them.

name: update_identifiers

changes_awaiting_backfill.description: How many edits on this website, from anyone, wait for the backfill on the Competitors page. A count of edits, not of responses.
